# mcp-vault

> Local-first MCP secret vault (Merkle). docs/arch is architecture SoT; doc/arch is the speckit control plane. Prefer exit code 0 and --json.

## Protocol

spec-first: read the corpus before code. Config families: project, adr, guard, git, hygiene, privacy, semantic, context, stats, dedupe.
